about:
Wallace Woodworks Artisans LLC was founded in 1982 by Jeff Wallace in South Salt Lake, Utah. Operating from a facility on South Main Street, the company has built a reputation for dependability and quality workmanship across Utah and nationwide.

The shop specializes in custom bespoke woodworking, producing kitchens, vanities, furniture, and architectural features. A team of craftsmen handles design consultation, material selection, and fabrication using high-quality materials and methods. Projects range from residential cabinetry to commercial installations such as private offices and club rooms.

Clients include homeowners and businesses seeking tailored wood creations. The company has completed projects locally in Utah and across the country, with testimonials highlighting work on private offices, bathrooms, kitchens, and specialty rooms.

Wallace Woodworks emphasizes master craftsmanship and attention to detail, guided by the principle that quality is remembered long after price is forgotten. The firm was started to provide exceptional value to those desiring unsurpassed quality in custom woodwork.
